LanguageData.LiAIChat_BlightAbsorberArmor.description: On polluted ground, this armor absorbs nearby pollution into a reserve of up to 100 energy. At 30 energy, activate a shield for up to 15 seconds; it spends energy to absorb incoming damage and has no separate timed cooldown. Absorption and activation build toxic accumulation. Detoxifier Lungs reduce this buildup, but do not prevent it.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_RetaliatorCarapace.description: When a hostile melee attacker deals at least 2 damage, the carapace has a 40% chance to retaliate for 6 stabbing damage and apply a 10-second mild venom. Spines recover for 3 seconds after a retaliation. Wearing the armor and triggering spines both add dermal erosion; ranged and environmental damage do not trigger them.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_ResonanceMantle.description: Activate an 8-cell resonance field for 20 seconds; it disrupts hostile biological pawns (5% consciousness and 4% manipulation penalty) and ignores mechanoids and allies. Cooldown: 90 seconds. The field builds neural resonance strain while active, and severe strain prevents activation.
